plan.hypothesis: On the retained two-flexible-segment T0 structure under the fixed controller controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, decreasing control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight from its 0.05 nominal to the lower domain bound 0.025 (terminal_tip_speed_weight held at its 0.1 bound and all other fields frozen) will reduce the maximum tip speed inside the 0.05 s hold window below the 0.02 m/s bound while keeping terminal error within 0.01 m, force bounds satisfied and a finite valid execution, converting a rejected near-miss into a joint reach-and-hold acceptance without any structural change.
plan.rationale: Control-only research is legitimate and only the two tip-speed weights are legal continuous control paths; terminal_tip_speed_weight is pinned at its 0.1 upper bound so the only free direction is a decrease, and holding_tip_speed_weight is the natural lever. The batch source is the packet's current_batch_source batch-0497cdd238512a92-0 (execution 1c4123beee034c078c079e46eac42b4b), a completed controller10 evaluation on the retained T0 structure that is distinct from both the latest tested configuration (batch-67047ea375b20a2c-1) and the retained baseline (fixed-radius); branching from it keeps the frozen template, routing and force-capacity conditions unchanged. With one development execution remaining (study.development_used 5 of 6, executable backend_solves 1), a single explicit point at the lower holding-weight bound is the highest-value, most conservative probe: it is a genuine new configuration, needs no replication_reason, and each point must return a complete evaluation with force bounds and a finite valid execution before any acceptance or improvement claim.
stopping_conditions: single-batch backend cap of 1 new attempt reached
weakening_observations: Historical T0/T2 metrics were produced by controller 9.0.0, while this batch runs the fixed controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, so the recorded held-speed values may not transfer.

Terminal error 0.0031 m is already inside the 0.01 m bound, so the residual joint failure may be structure-limited rather than weight-limited, and no recorded evidence causally links the holding weight to held tip speed.
A matched repeat at holding weight 0.05 shows a substantial run-to-run spread in held speed, so a single new point cannot separate a real weight effect from numerical scatter.
T2 carries split-guide/routing and independent force capacity that confound cross-template attribution.

interpretations.scope: controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0 recipe domain, nominal case, seed 17.
interpretations.statement: The only control-only continuous levers authorized in this scheduling context are control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight. terminal_tip_speed_weight already sits at its 0.1 upper bound, so it cannot be increased and only a decrease is a legal change; holding_tip_speed_weight (nominal 0.05) can move in either direction within [0.025, 0.1].
interpretations.uncertainty: This is a domain-bounds statement only; it does not establish that any particular weight change improves the physical held-window outcome.

interpretations.scope: frozen_pre_experiment_background, nominal case, seed 17, historical controller 9.0.0 executions.
interpretations.statement: The retained comparison T0 (fixed-radius, execution 197bceb6ff8f44b48a35bc4f79b3528d) is a completed valid execution whose only recorded acceptance miss is held tip speed 0.0268 m/s against the 0.02 m/s bound, while terminal error 0.0031 m and held position 0.0034 m are both inside the 0.01 m bound; the three-segment T2 variant instead fails jointly (held position 0.0234 m, held speed 1.121 m/s, joint pass false). Speed-weight adaptation is therefore the indicated control-only intervention.
interpretations.uncertainty: Historical version9 evidence is not transferable to controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0 without a fresh execution, and a matched repeat shows a non-trivial run-to-run spread on held speed.

decision.reasoning: Feedback first: the latest completed batch reports status completed (F1515) with stop_reason proposal_limit (F1513), so a bounded batch ran to its proposal cap without attaining acceptance, and the current_batch_source is a completed controller10 evaluation on the retained T0 structure. The only legal control-only continuous levers are control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight; terminal_tip_speed_weight already sits at its 0.1 upper bound (F354), so it cannot be raised and only a decrease is available, while holding_tip_speed_weight starts at 0.05 (F497). The retained comparison T0 (fixed-radius) is a completed valid execution whose single binding deficiency is held tip speed 0.0268 m/s (F28) against the 0.02 m/s bound, with holding position 0.0034 m (F284) and terminal error 0.0031 m inside 0.01 m; the three-segment T2 variant instead fails jointly on both held position (F1) and held speed (F224) with joint pass false (F192) and a valid_failure status (F3). Against that, a pure speed-weight change on the conserved T0 structure is the indicated, cheapest control-only intervention: because increasing the holding weight tracked a larger measured held speed in the most recent history while the source configuration sits at 0.05, I probe a single decrease to the holding weight's lower domain bound 0.025 under the fixed controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, holding terminal at 0.1 and freezing all other fields. With only one development execution left, a single explicit point (method search.family_explicit@1.0.0, step null, one candidate, one backend cap) is used rather than a multi-point coordinate search; the numeric scores will guide interpretation but only the actual terminal-error, held-position and held-speed metrics with force bounds and a finite valid execution can support any claim. Historical version9 metrics do not certify the controller10 outcome, hence the uncertain promise.
unresolved_uncertainties: Whether decreasing holding_tip_speed_weight actually lowers the physical held tip speed under controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, or whether the residual miss is structure-limited.
How far historical controller 9.0.0 metrics transfer to the fixed controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, given a matched repeat already shows material run-to-run spread.
Whether a single point at the lower bound can cross the 0.02 m/s acceptance bound without pushing terminal error back outside 0.01 m or violating force bounds.
